summary: VV has none of TV's hatch, vector-editing, Boolean/holes or dimension-style work: zero occurrences of Hatch, Shape__Holes, Shape__Curve, Na__LeVec, Na__LeRings, Dimension__RoundUp/LinePt/LineStyle/StartExtensionMm in VV source. TV-only in this slice: LE/36__System__HatchPatternTools (3 files, 1,480 lines), LE/37__System__VectorTools (18 files, 7,385 lines), LE/15 ShapeRings + DimensionRounding (487 lines), the app-root 52__LayoutEditor__HatchPatternLibrary (24 files) and 4 Node suites (1,671 lines). All 11 shared files (7 drawing tools, ShapeGeometry, DimensionGeometry, Panel__Shapes, Panel__Dimensions) are pure 'VV behind TV' drift: a header-stripped code diff found no VV seam except the VV-only Snapping import, so each becomes a verbatim body port gated on dependencies. Critical trap: TV ObjectSnap Sources statically imports VectorTools Curves - Curves (a pure leaf) must land before the ObjectSnap folder. Most TV-only modules here are import-free leaves and can land first, inert. No transport work: the hatch library and configs are static files resolved from import.meta.url; VV's Flask already serves /ValeVision3D/<path>. External prerequisites: ObjectSnap (28), OrthoMode/DrawingGrid State, ViewportRotation, PaintOrder, IsLayerSelectable, KeyMap When-support, SheetModel/SheetRecords/SheetChrome/MarkupBridge hunks. VV still has TV's fixed v2.106 bug (Edges off on several vectors repaints every fill). Version numbers are not comparable across the apps (VV renumbered several ports) - use the content map in the report. 11 work packages, 7 decisions (hatch packs, Patterns panel without site plans, ShapeGeometry QR/Image branches, keys, a probable TV defect where new shapes ignore the Hatch default, version policy, sign-off).
